setting.codexHome: Codex home (parent of sessions). Empty uses CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex. Remote windows read the remote host.
setting.refreshSeconds: Fallback polling interval in seconds. File changes trigger incremental reads.
setting.maxSessions: Number of recent sessions to list. Only the selected session is fully parsed.
setting.autoRefreshHover: Automatically synchronize changed hover content in five-second windows. Native tooltips may redraw. Disable for manual snapshots; the sidebar stays live.
setting.language: Language for dashboards, session picker and hover. Commands and settings labels follow the VS Code display language.
